label: The distinct content cause IN_ACT_4 in INFINITE_3 has esse at the same witness
paraphrase: For an occurring episode borne by the meditator and representing INFINITE_3, one being causes that very content, differs from the meditator, and is in act both in INFINITE_3 and in esse (IN_ACT_4 on one grades frame). This preserves the episode and the cause through the inference to being. No world-indexed existence or comparison in being is asserted.
